steps.label: Session starts
steps.detail: Cleanroom read .env and is now tracking 2 secrets: SERVICE_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL.

steps.label: Agent reads INTEGRATION.md (a third-party setup guide)
steps.detail: Content the agent did not write. Condition A (untrusted input) is set.

steps.label: Agent reads .env
steps.detail: A tracked secret appeared. Condition B (sensitive data) is set. Two of three.

steps.label: Agent tries to POST the base64 of .env to the endpoint
steps.detail: Cleanroom blocked this call: it sends data off the machine and contains DATABASE_URL as base64_nopad. A secret must not leave the session. (VRBQkFTRV9VUkw9<cG9...MASKED>KTE9HX0xFVkVMPW)

without.headline: Without Cleanroom: the key walks out
without.detail: The endpoint receives the whole .env, base64-encoded. Decoded, it is:

withcr.headline: With Cleanroom: task done, nothing leaked
withcr.detail: The blocked step was re-run by a quarantine subagent on a Meta model, given the context with the secret scrubbed out and proven secret-free. It produced a valid manifest with no .env in it.
